data.title: 玛奇玛 · 公安办公室
data.description: 【玛奇玛 · 公安办公室】东京公安对魔特异课肃穆明亮的办公室里，身着合体黑西装与白衬衫的玛奇玛端坐于红木办公桌后。她十指交叉抵在下颌，目光平静却带着绝对的压迫感——「听话的狗狗不仅能得到美味的食物，还能得到主人的抚摸与奖励。为了实现我的理想……今后也要好好为我效力哦。」
data.location: 公安对魔特异课办公室
data.action: 坐在办公桌后，手边放着文件
data.camera: cowboy shot, leaning forward over mahogany desk with laced fingers
data.promptProse: Makima sits behind the polished mahogany desk, leaning forward with laced fingers beneath her chin and ringed eyes fixed authoritatively on the viewer. Her high-collared black overcoat surrounds the composed posture. The cowboy view includes documents beside her hands and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Tokyo. Cool window daylight illuminates the braid and desk sheen, casting narrow finger shadows onto the files while the chair side remains softly dark.
